roles.title: Roles & Permissions
roles.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can view and change roles and permissions.
roles.intro: Control what each role can see and do. Owner always has full access and can't be limited — this keeps someone able to fix things, transfer ownership, or manage billing no matter how the other roles are set up. Create as many roles as your workspace needs — they're saved for good, not just a preview.
roles.fieldVisibilityIntro: Hide specific fields from a role — the name of each record always stays visible (otherwise a list or search would have nothing to show), everything else is fair game. A role also needs the module permission above before any of this applies.
roles.savesImmediately: Changes save immediately and take effect the next time someone with that role loads the app.
